text: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Publication regarding hearing of Petition in connection with the Scheme of Amalgamation of Utkarsh CoreInvest Limited with Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Limited

Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 02, 2026, titled "Glenmark Advances Multi-Country Phase 3 Clinical Trial of Trastuzumab rezetecan in Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer".
